principle: Every quantity a decision reads must have been observable at or before the decision instant, and no future mutation may change a historical decision.

time_semantics.bar_open_time_ms: provider kline field 0 (epoch ms, UTC), the bar's start
time_semantics.bar_close_time_ms: provider kline field 6 (epoch ms, UTC), the bar's end
time_semantics.bar_span: [bar_open_time_ms, bar_close_time_ms]; for 5m bars close = open + 299999 ms
time_semantics.decision_time_ms: the close_time_ms of the signal bar - the first instant at which the complete ARC-03 signal is knowable
time_semantics.entry_time_ms: the open_time_ms of the entry bar
time_semantics.exit_time_ms: the open_time_ms of the exit bar (= entry_time_ms + 3600000)
time_semantics.funding_time_ms: the settlement instant of a certified funding row (== availability_time_ms == settlement_time_ms)

clauses.name: bar_close_time_le_decision_time
clauses.statement: Every bar read by a decision satisfies bar_close_time_ms <= decision_time_ms.
clauses.enforcement: only completed bars are readable; the forming bar is invisible
clauses.test: evaluate_bar() reads only the signal bar at its close and the 30 trailing same-slot references, each of which closed at least 86400000 ms earlier

clauses.name: reference_slots_le_decision_time
clauses.statement: Every same-slot reference bar satisfies bar_close_time_ms <= decision_time_ms.
clauses.enforcement: reference slots are decision_bar_open_time_ms - 86400000*j for j = 1..30, so each one closes ~24h before the decision

clauses.name: entry_strictly_after_decision
clauses.statement: entry_time_ms > decision_time_ms; same-bar entry is impossible.
clauses.enforcement: entry is the OPEN of the first bar with open_time_ms > decision_time_ms. Since decision_time_ms is the close of bar t, the first qualifying bar is t+1.
clauses.test: synthetic fixtures assert entry_time_ms >= decision_time_ms + 1 for every emitted signal, including bars whose close time is an exact 5m boundary and bars whose close time carries millisecond jitter

clauses.name: exit_anchor_causal
clauses.statement: The exit bar is identified by clock arithmetic only (entry_time_ms + 3600000); no forward price or outcome information enters signal eligibility.
clauses.enforcement: the only forward question asked is 'does the exit bar exist inside the admitted partition'. The exit PRICE is never inspected to decide whether to trade.

clauses.name: funding_cashflow_window_disjoint_from_signal_window
clauses.statement: Funding settlements are read only in (entry_time_ms, exit_time_ms], which is strictly after decision_time_ms; funding is never a signal input for ARC-03.
clauses.enforcement: the funding authority module is not importable from the signal path

clauses.name: future_mutation_invariance
clauses.statement: Mutating any bar with bar_open_time_ms > decision_time_ms leaves the emitted direction, the reason code and the feature values at decision_time_ms unchanged.
clauses.enforcement: the evaluation reads a bounded, purely trailing window
clauses.test: adversarial battery mutates future bars (up to +30 days) and asserts byte-identical feature records

clauses.name: past_eligible_mutation_detectable
clauses.statement: Mutating an eligible reference bar (a same-slot slot inside the 30-day reference set) can change participation_shock, excursion_record and the emitted direction.
clauses.enforcement: the test is non-vacuous: a battery that cannot change anything would prove nothing

clauses.name: exact_duplicates_collapse
clauses.statement: Byte-identical duplicate rows collapse deterministically (one kept); a partition containing a duplicate bar-open slot raises CONFLICTING_OR_DUPLICATE_SLOT and fails closed.
clauses.enforcement: load_partition() raises on duplicate slots; the normalizer records exact_duplicate_rows_collapsed

clauses.name: conflicting_duplicates_fail_closed
clauses.statement: A month containing a conflicting duplicate is withheld whole from the authority; a partition with a conflicting duplicate fails closed rather than picking a winner.

clauses.name: missing_stale_fails_closed
clauses.statement: Fewer than 30 complete same-slot reference observations, or a missing exit bar, fails the decision closed with an explicit NO_SIGNAL reason.
clauses.enforcement: NO_SIGNAL / REFERENCE_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE and NO_SIGNAL / INSUFFICIENT_FORWARD_PRICE_DATA; no interpolation, no forward-fill, no synthesis

clauses.name: archive_validity_not_retroactive
clauses.statement: A later archive or authority admission cannot alter a decision evaluated at an earlier decision instant.
clauses.enforcement: eligibility is a pure function of the frozen partition bytes and the decision instant; the normalizer's validity classification is not consulted at runtime

clauses.name: no_unadmitted_field
clauses.statement: No field other than open/high/low/close/volume (and close_time as the completion anchor) is read by the signal.
clauses.enforcement: the reader loads quote volume, trade count and taker-buy fields for inventory transparency only; evaluate_bar() never references them

clauses.name: forward_price_guard_is_clock_only_censoring
clauses.statement: A decision whose exit bar would fall outside the admitted partition or beyond end_ms is dropped with NO_SIGNAL / INSUFFICIENT_FORWARD_PRICE_DATA. This is structural clock censoring based on whether a complete outcome can exist - no knowledge of the outcome itself.
clauses.enforcement: the last 60 minutes of the common window therefore emit no trades

fail_closed_policy: any violation of a clause above is a NO_SIGNAL (fail closed) at the decision level, and an INFRASTRUCTURE_FAIL at the execution level if it arises from a broken authority rather than from missing data
violation_classification: PIT violation recorded during execution is INFRASTRUCTURE_FAIL, never a strategy failure
